metadata.title: The SQL Interview Bug Even a Correct-Looking Query Can Hide
metadata.description: CLI-explainer: an interview-style 'top track per user' SQL query that runs cleanly, looks correct, and silently returns two rows for a tied user. RANK() to ROW_NUMBER() revision fixes it. Sourced from Chapter 4 (window functions, Exercise 3) with a one-beat tie-in to Chapter 7's AI-code-judgment theme.
